title: MYTH BUSTER CONTINUATION — Catherine, James, G.E.C.K. and Fallout Timeline Forensics
scope: Resolve the identity and death circumstances of Catherine, reject the stolen-child hypothesis for the Lone Wanderer, distinguish Project Purity from the pre-War G.E.C.K., and place Fallout 3 correctly within the canonical series timeline.

catherine_identity.name: Catherine
catherine_identity.role: scientist, wife of James, co-originator of Project Purity, biological mother of the Lone Wanderer
catherine_identity.death_context: Catherine gave birth at the Jefferson Memorial; shortly afterward she suffered cardiac arrest and died.
catherine_identity.medical_context: The Project Purity team had scavenged and inadequate medical equipment, reducing the likelihood of successful emergency treatment.
catherine_identity.technical_model_warning: The shipped NPC asset uses an 'Old' race variant and gray hair, but this is not a reliable canonical age statement because Catherine is not normally viewed directly and her exact age is never stated in lore.
catherine_identity.claim_ceiling: Do not assign a numeric age to Catherine without a canonical source.

catherine_janus_parallel.canonical_role: Catherine's favorite Bible passage inspired Project Purity's language and the waters-of-life motif.
catherine_janus_parallel.event_structure: CATHERINE_END <-> LONE_WANDERER_BEGINNING occurs in the same childbirth event.
catherine_janus_parallel.janus_interpretation: The beginning/end polarity is a strong Janus-compatible structural parallel, but the literal referent in Fallout 3 is biblical, not Janus.

stolen_child_hypothesis.hypothesis: James stole the Lone Wanderer from Little Lamplight or another source and falsely presented the child as Catherine's biological child.
independent_evidence_against: Project Purity journals document Catherine's pregnancy before childbirth.
The opening birth scene directly depicts Catherine giving birth.
Catherine refers to the newborn as her and James's son/daughter.
James likewise identifies the newborn as their child.
Madison Li is present at the delivery and independently confirms the family history later.
James's post-birth journal explicitly treats the child as the surviving child of Catherine and himself.
Star Paladin Cross later confirms travel involving James and the infant after Catherine's death.
The game production system partially matches James's face geometry to the player-created Lone Wanderer, reinforcing intended biological parentage at the authoring level.
stolen_child_hypothesis.remaining_exotic_substitution_variant: A hypothetical post-birth infant substitution would require an unsupported multi-character conspiracy and has no discovered shipped evidence.

project_purity.purpose: Large-scale purification of the irradiated Tidal Basin to provide clean water freely to the Capital Wasteland.
project_purity.relationship_to_geck: The original Project Purity predates James's knowledge of the G.E.C.K.; the G.E.C.K. is later pursued as a missing technological component capable of making the stalled purification concept viable at scale.

geck_correction.creator: Dr. Stanislaus Braun
geck_correction.organization: Future-Tec, a division of Vault-Tec Corporation
geck_correction.james_initial_knowledge: The G.E.C.K. was foreign to James; he regarded descriptions of it as bordering on fantasy despite Braun's reputation.
geck_correction.how_james_learned: While living in Vault 101, James discovered information tying Braun to the Societal Preservation Program and G.E.C.K. research and learned that Braun had a place in Vault 112.
geck_correction.why_vault112: James deliberately sought Braun and/or his research because even a fraction of Braun's work might provide the missing solution for Project Purity.
geck_correction.compressed: BRAUN CREATED GECK; JAMES CREATED PROJECT PURITY AND LATER SOUGHT GECK TECHNOLOGY.

sequence: James learns of Braun/G.E.C.K./Societal Preservation material while inside Vault 101
James later leaves Vault 101 and resumes Project Purity
Project Purity still requires a breakthrough
Braun/Betty imprisons James in a dog avatar named Doc
the Lone Wanderer enters the same simulation and frees James
tranquility_lane_bridge.identity_parallel: JAMES_DOCTOR -> DOC_DOG_AVATAR is a direct identity-role rewrite inside a simulated threshold system.

vault87_development_bridge.early_story: An earlier Fallout 3 story concept placed James in Vault 87 undergoing super-mutant transformation.
vault87_development_bridge.final_story: The released game places James in Vault 112 undergoing virtual identity transformation, while his child later reaches Vault 87 through Little Lamplight to obtain the G.E.C.K.
vault87_development_bridge.interpretive_rewrite_hypothesis: A transformation function may have migrated from the early Vault 87 father plot into the final Vault 112/Tranquility Lane father plot, while Vault 87 remained on the child's continuation path.

timeline_correction.fallout3_relationship: Fallout 3 is a later mainline East Coast story in the same continuity, not a pre-Fallout-1 spinoff.

why_confusion_is_easy: Fallout 3 heavily features pre-War technology, old Vault experiments and characters such as Braun whose key inventions predate the Great War.
The G.E.C.K. existed long before Fallout 1 even though Fallout 2 and Fallout 3 make it a major quest object.
Tranquility Lane visually recreates pre-War America, making a 2277 quest look like an event from before the nuclear war.

ru: Версия о краже Одинокого Путника отвергается: беременность, роды и независимые свидетели поддерживают биологическое родство Catherine, James и ребёнка.
Возраст Catherine каноном не установлен; техническая модель персонажа не должна превращаться в выдуманную дату рождения.
James не создавал G.E.C.K.; G.E.C.K. был довоенной разработкой Stanislaus Braun и Future-Tec.
James и Catherine создали Project Purity, а G.E.C.K. позднее стал найденным ими технологическим ключом к его завершению.
Fallout 3 происходит в 2277 году — позже Fallout 1 (2161) и Fallout 2 (2241), а не до них.
Довоенное происхождение Braun и G.E.C.K. не делает Fallout 3 приквелом: древняя технология встроена в более позднюю историю.
en: The stolen-child theory is rejected: pregnancy, childbirth and independent witnesses support Catherine and James as the Lone Wanderer's biological parents.
Catherine's exact age is not established by canon; a technical NPC model must not be converted into an invented birth date.
James did not create the G.E.C.K.; it was a pre-War development of Stanislaus Braun and Future-Tec.
James and Catherine created Project Purity, while the G.E.C.K. later became a technological key sought to complete it.
Fallout 3 takes place in 2277, after Fallout 1 (2161) and Fallout 2 (2241), not before them.
The pre-War origin of Braun and the G.E.C.K. does not make Fallout 3 a prequel; old technology is embedded inside a later story.
